test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: There is 10% water in a 40-liter solution of milk and water. If 10 litres of water are added to this solution, then what percentage of the new solution will be water?
solution:
Given:

The total mixture of milk and water is 40 L

Calculation:

⇒ The total water of in mixture = 40 × (10/100) = 4 L

⇒ The new quantity of mixture = 40 + 10 = 50

⇒ The total water of in new mixture = 4 + 10 = 14

⇒ The percentage of milk in the new mixture = (14/50) × 100 = 28%

∴ The required result will be 28%.
